name: manual_c8fb94
claim: When subagent model tier is specified as Gemini 3.8 Flash Medium or similar, never pass inherit in invoke_subagent if the parent model differs; verify or map the model explicitly.

decisions.notes: Observed 2026-11-28: Passing inherit caused subagents to run as Gemini 4 Hydrogen because the parent session was on Hydrogen, violating the user's strict requirement for Gemini 3.8 Flash medium.

rationale: Observed 2026-11-28: Passing inherit caused subagents to run as Gemini 4 Hydrogen because the parent session was on Hydrogen, violating the user's strict requirement for Gemini 3.8 Flash medium.
